# FiveM NUI/UI

Inspect existing family, organization, and `cm-ui` interfaces before redesigning. Preserve CM cyan/ice-blue styling, hierarchy, responsive scaling, local assets, and focus lifecycle. Validate messages and DOM elements, avoid per-frame rebuilds and oversized payloads, preserve callback names, and ensure close/ESC restores focus. Do not use `backdrop-filter` or purple as the main accent.
